Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 shows a normal chest X-ray (arrows indicate normal vascular markings), while Figure 2 demonstrates new, dense consolidation in the right middle and lower lung fields. This focal opacity, combined with the clinical presentation of sudden worsening, pleuritic pain, and crackles 18 days after admission for COVID-19, is most characteristic of a superimposed bacterial pneumonia rather than diffuse progression of viral disease or other etiologies.
